description: A balding older man in a black frock coat and bow tie raises his right hand and rests his left on a large leather-bound book, while a man in a black judicial robe with white hair faces him and gestures. They stand in a grand chamber with dark marble columns, red and gold drapes, and a tiered gallery of seated and standing onlookers. A tall window with light falls behind them, and a seated man in a dark suit is at the left edge. Papers lie on the table, and the scene reads as 19th-century American in dress and furnishings.
